name: claude-code-changelog-viewer
description: Claude Codeの更新履歴をどこよりも分かりやすく表示するWebサイト
author: sui

scripts.notify:migrate: bun run --filter notification-worker wrangler d1 migrations apply notification-db --remote
scripts.notify:migrate:local: bun run --filter notification-worker wrangler d1 migrations apply notification-db --local
scripts.format: biome format --write ./apps ./packages && bun run --filter www format
scripts.type-check: bun run --filter '*' type-check && bun run --filter www check
scripts.type-check:ai: bun run --filter '*' type-check && bun run --filter www check
scripts.test: bun run --filter notification-worker test && bun run --filter changelog-fetcher test
scripts.test:coverage: bun run --filter notification-worker test:coverage && bun run --filter changelog-fetcher test:coverage
scripts.ai-check: bun run format && bun run lint:ai && bun run type-check:ai
scripts.similarity: similarity-ts --exclude node_modules --exclude dist --exclude .astro --exclude changelogs --exclude analysis --exclude inferred --exclude metadata --exclude '*.d.ts' .
